nodes.description: Public token name string stored in contract storage, set once in constructor.
Public token symbol string stored in contract storage, set once in constructor.
Public uint8 token decimals, set to 3 in constructor.
Public uint256 total token supply initialized to 10000000000000 in constructor.
mapping(address => uint) of token balances, mutated by constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowance table, mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Constructor: sets name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and mints full supply to msg.sender.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction.
View function returning balances[tokenOwner] for a supplied owner address.
View function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Transfers tokens from 'from' to 'to' debiting both balance and allowance of msg.sender.
Pure helper returning a + b with an overflow require check.
Pure helper returning a - b with a require(b <= a) underflow check.
Pure helper returning a * b with an overflow require check.
Pure helper returning a / b with a require(b > 0) division-by-zero check.
Caller-controlled address used as balance/allowance owner and mint recipient.
Unchecked arithmetic: _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] can revert/underflow if the zero address ever holds a balance.
State mutation in transfer: balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(...) then balances[to] = safeAdd(...).
State mutation in transferFrom: debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], then credits balances[to].
State mutation in approve: allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without any allowance-reset protection.
Spender address parameter of approve and allowance.
Amount parameter of approve, transfer and transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter of transfer and transferFrom.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Local result variable c in safeAdd.
Local result variable c in safeSub.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mint recipient and initial balance owner in the constructor.
msg.sender determines which allowance slot approve writes, so the caller controls the owner key.
msg.sender is the debited account in transfer, letting the caller move only its own funds but fully controlling the source.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is debited in transferFrom while tokens move from an arbitrary 'from'.
Constructor assigns the initial _totalSupply value.
Constructor writes the whole supply into balances[msg.sender].
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)].
totalSupply performs a raw subtraction that can underflow to an enormous value.
The unchecked subtraction result is derived from _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approve writes the allowance mapping.
approve blindly overwrites the caller's allowance slot without validating the new value against the current one.
The allowance write operation mutates allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transfer performs the balance state mutations whose values come from arithmetic helpers.
The transfer mutation writes the computed balances into the balances mapping.
transfer updates balances[msg.sender] and balances[to], affecting observable token state.
transferFrom calls safeSub twice, for the balance and the allowance debit.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom performs the balance and allowance state mutations fed by arithmetic helpers.
The transferFrom mutation writes debited and credited balances.
The transferFrom mutation decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
safeSub results are written back into balances by transfer and transferFrom.
safeAdd results are written back into balances by transfer and transferFrom.
safeSub stores its computed result in the local variable c.
safeAdd stores its computed result in the local variable c.
The spender parameter determines the allowance slot written by approve.
The spender parameter indexes the allowance lookup in allowance.
The tokens parameter is the raw value stored as allowance in approve.
The tokens parameter is the amount subtracted and added in transfer.
The tokens parameter is the amount debited from balance and allowance in transferFrom.
The to parameter receives the credited balance in transfer.
The to parameter receives the credited balance in transferFrom.
The from parameter is an externally supplied account debited in transferFrom without an explicit allowance check before mutation.

normalization_plan.reason: spender is only a formal parameter of approve (and allowance) and should be folded into the approve function node.
tokens is a transient amount parameter consumed by the transfer arithmetic helpers and written into state by transfer.
to is a transient recipient parameter used only to index balances during transfer.
from is a transient source parameter used only to index balances during transferFrom.
c is a local temporary holding the safeAdd return value inside the safeAdd function.
c is a local temporary holding the safeSub return value inside the safeSub function.
